segments.text: Criminology studies crime, criminal behaviour, causes of offending, criminal justice, investigation, punishment, prevention and modern forms of crime. FPSC divides the paper into four 25-mark sections.

items.text: Prepare one question from every section because FPSC papers commonly require sectional choice.
thinker/idea → assumptions → explanation of crime → criticism → Pakistan application.
For contemporary topics add current examples only from verified sources.
Use Pakistan’s legal/institutional context without turning answers into newspaper summaries.

segments.text: Build the subject in four layers: basic concepts; theories of why crime occurs; institutions that investigate, judge and correct offending; and modern crime problems. Every analytical answer should combine definition, explanation, evidence or theory, criticism and a realistic prevention or reform dimension.
